_about: One scheme, shared by PZB01G and POMIFD (both YouGov). Values are already
clean statements about a person, so this map is the identity — it exists so
the field is DECLARED as checked rather than merely unreported, and so a
second scheme has somewhere to land.
'Living as married' is kept distinct from 'Married' rather than folded in.
They are different legal and social states and the source separates them.
NOTHING IS COLLAPSED HERE, deliberately. There is one scheme, so there is no
second vocabulary to reconcile against and no pressure to coarsen. Rolling the
denominations up to the ONS religion groups, or the tenures up to own/rent,
would destroy detail nobody has asked us to lose in exchange for a comparability
that does not yet have a second party. When UKHLS arrives with its own variables
— and it will, SN 6849 carries both — that is the moment to decide the canonical,
with both schemes in view. Designing it now from one scheme risks exactly the
one-way-street problem in persona/categories.py: a canonical fixed too early
